integrity: Complete graph LCF prescription, finite exhaustive Morse/automorphism checker, and structural join proof are provided. Computed evidence is claimed only for the enumerated finite graph; independent external audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Canonical 18-vertex Pappus graph and inclusive vertex shortest-path metric only. Scale-two integral homology lattice as a full module, integral quotient torsion, and homotopy actions are not classified. The related indexed Pappus intrinsic Cech nerve source was inaccessible in full; unindexed equivalent research remains possible.
title: The Pappus graph has a six-block Rips sphere filtration with a surviving quotient class
